description: Set up the working branch and establish/confirm the baseline for Site1. Since this is a static HTML/CSS project with no build or test tooling, 'baseline' means confirming the current site renders and capturing its current state before redesign. This feature is intentionally small and exists to create a clean feature branch and verify the starting point.
steps: From the repo root /projects/sandbox/edu-profile-demo, create and check out a feature branch named 'fix/site1-mature-redesign' (git checkout -b fix/site1-mature-redesign). Do NOT work on main. Do NOT push.
Confirm the working tree is clean and you are on the new branch (git status, git branch --show-current).

Read site1/index.html and site1/style.css fully to internalize the current structure, the CSS custom-property theming, the dark-mode checkbox-hack selectors (#dark-mode-toggle:checked ~ ...), and the mobile-nav checkbox hack.
Verify the starting point has no JavaScript: confirm there are zero '<script' occurrences in site1/index.html.

Record in findings: the current font choices, primary/accent color values, the list of sections in document order, and the specific childish elements you will target (emojis, looping animations, purple hero gradient, pastel gradients, pill shapes).
acceptance_criteria: A feature branch 'fix/site1-mature-redesign' exists and is checked out (git branch --show-current prints it).
No changes have been committed to main.
site1/index.html contains zero '<script' tags (still pure HTML/CSS).
Findings document the current fonts, colors, section order, and the childish elements to be addressed.
verification: Run: grep -c '<script' site1/index.html  -> returns 0 (grep exits non-zero / prints 0)
Run: git -C /projects/sandbox/edu-profile-demo status  -> shows the branch and a clean or expected tree
findings:
BASELINE CONFIRMED for FEAT-002 implementation.

BRANCH: 'fix/site1-mature-redesign' created from main and checked out (git branch --show-current confirms). No changes committed to main; only the .agents/ task files and this branch exist. site1 files were NOT modified in this feature.

NO JAVASCRIPT: grep -c '<script' site1/index.html => 0 (grep exit 1). Site is pure HTML/CSS. prefers-reduced-motion block exists at end of style.css and must be preserved.

FONTS (Google Fonts CDN <link> in index.html <head>): body = 'Inter' (weights 300;400;500;600;700;800); headings (h1,h2, .nav-brand, .footer-tagline, .testimonial-quote, avatar SVG) = 'Playfair Display' (weights 400;500;600;700;800). Both referenced in :root via font-family declarations directly (no --font custom props; fonts are hardcoded in rules).

COLOR CUSTOM PROPERTIES (:root, light theme):
- --primary #6C8EBF, --primary-light #8CAAD4, --primary-dark #4a6d9c, --primary-glow rgba(108,142,191,0.4)
- --accent #E8A87C (peach), --accent-light #F0C4A8, --accent-dark #D4845A
- --secondary #85CDCA (mint), --secondary-dark #5FABA8
- Neutrals: --bg-primary #fafbfe, --bg-secondary #ffffff, --bg-tertiary #f0f4f8, --bg-card #ffffff, --bg-glass rgba(255,255,255,0.75), --bg-nav rgba(255,255,255,0.85)
- Text: --text-primary #1a2332, --text-secondary #4a5568, --text-muted #8896a7, --text-accent #6C8EBF
- Border: --border #e8edf3, --border-light #f0f4f8
- GRADIENTS: --gradient-hero linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2) [trendy purple], --gradient-accent linear-gradient(135deg,#6C8EBF,#85CDCA), --gradient-warm linear-gradient(135deg,#E8A87C,#6C8EBF), --gradient-separator linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--primary),transparent), --gradient-hero-overlay (faint purple).
- Radii: --border-radius 12px, --border-radius-lg 20px. Pill shapes use hardcoded 50px / 20px radius in many rules (cta, tag, social-btn, back-to-top, project-badge, project-stats, project-tags span).
DARK MODE overrides all bg/text/border/shadow vars under '#dark-mode-toggle:checked ~ .navbar, ~ main, ~ .mobile-nav-panel, ~ footer'. Must keep these 4 sibling selectors intact.

SECTION ORDER (document order in <main>): 1) #hero (avatar SVG KY, h1 name, subtitle, tagline, CTA), 2) #about, 3) #stats (Impact, 4 stat-cards), 4) skills (3 skill-category, tag-primary/accent/secondary pills), 5) #experience (timeline, Experience & Education), 6) achievements (8 achievement-cards w/ emoji icons), 7) testimonials (3 cards, large Playfair quote glyph), 8) funfacts (Fun Facts, 6 fact-cards w/ large emojis), 9) #projects (4 project-cards, featured + gradient-1..4 banners), 10) learning (Currently Exploring, 4 learning-cards w/ emoji icons), 11) #connect (social, LinkedIn/GitHub/Email SVG btns). Then <footer> (separator, tagline, meta 'Built with sparkle-emoji', #GivetoGain, back-to-top).

CHILDISH ELEMENTS TO TARGET in FEAT-002:
1. EMOJIS: achievement-icon (8 emojis: trophy/scroll/star/hammer/mic/books/robot/people HTML entities 🏆 etc.), fact-emoji (6 emojis), learning-icon (4 emojis: robot/zap/globe/chart), footer sparkle ✨, project-stats star ⭐ and bowl 🍴. Replace with restrained iconography or remove.
2. LOOPING/BOUNCY ANIMATIONS: @keyframes glow (avatar-ring pulsing shadow, infinite), float (avatar SVG bob, infinite), pulse (scale 1.05, infinite), shimmer. Also scale-up hovers (dark-mode-label scale(1.1), timeline-dot scale(1.2)). Keep fadeInUp/fadeIn entrance only; remove infinite loops.
3. PURPLE HERO GRADIENT: --gradient-hero #667eea->#764ba2 and --gradient-hero-overlay. Replace with restrained/editorial treatment.
4. PASTEL/CANDY PALETTE: --accent peach #E8A87C and --secondary mint #85CDCA used as decorative gradients (--gradient-accent, --gradient-warm) on section-accent bars, cta, testimonial-avatar, timeline line, stat-card top bar. Replace with muted editorial accent.
5. PILL SHAPES: 50px radius on cta, tag, social-btn, back-to-top; 20px on badges/tags. Reduce to restrained radii.
6. COLORFUL PROJECT BANNERS: gradient-1..4 (blue/green/mauve/lavender). Replace with restrained treatment.
7. LARGE DECORATIVE QUOTE GLYPH: .testimonial-quote 4rem Playfair '“'.

PRESERVE: all text content, CSS-only dark mode (4 sibling selectors), mobile-nav checkbox hack (#nav-toggle), backdrop-filter @supports fallback, .section animation-fill-mode safety net, responsive breakpoints (900px/600px), prefers-reduced-motion block. Checkboxes #dark-mode-toggle and #nav-toggle must stay direct siblings of .navbar/main/.mobile-nav-panel/footer.
